title: 第111章 你们太不理智了！

content_zh: 炎文帝虽然相信唐逸，但现在心底也有些发毛。　　今日这出大戏，他玩得非常大，几乎没有留退路。　　这要是玩砸了，那乐子可就大了。　　他是想要用唐逸打压一下这群朝中大臣的嚣张气焰，可别气焰没打到，自己先把自己的脸给打了。　　“混账东西，你到底在干什么？”　　唐敬脸色阴沉，哪怕炎文帝已经确定了唐逸的身份，在他眼中，唐逸依旧远不如唐画。　　唐画都没写出来，他唐逸凭什么先写出来？　　“哼！陛下叫你小诗仙，你还真当自己是神仙了？”刘温，赵柯等一众大臣也都冷笑了起来。　　皇帝刚刚用唐逸，狠狠在他们脸上踩了一脚。　　现在，他们巴不得唐逸出丑呢！　　而且，他们是大炎位高权重的文臣，是大炎文坛顶级的那一小撮人物，很清楚要写出一首绝佳的诗词有多难。　　否则，他们早就是名动天下的大儒了。　　“白痴，不知道用什么办法诓骗陛下成了小诗仙就算了，现在竟然这种场合，竟然还敢猖狂，简直找死！”　　颜霜玉盯着唐逸也是冷笑不已，她和唐敬一样，都不想承认唐逸优秀。　　她的儿子，岂能输给柳如玉那女人的儿子？　　“这样正好，像他这种废物，就该身败名裂，永世不得超生！”　　姜云娜站在颜霜玉的身侧，脸色依旧怨毒无比。　　唐逸几句话让她丢尽颜面，现在她迫不及待想要见到唐逸像狗一样，被唐画踩在脚下的样子。　　唐画，秦钰也都愣住了，原本他们故意提出让唐逸先，不是礼让，而是想让唐逸先丢人，却没想到唐逸竟然说……他已经写好诗词了？！　　在和他们说话的这一点点时间，他就写好诗词了？这怎么可能？　　就连孔诗岚此时俏脸也在微微僵硬，美眸仔细打量着唐逸。　　这题目可是她绞尽脑汁想出来的，难度不可谓不大，她的心思和老太傅一样，那就是不认为这群没有经历过情爱的少年郎，会写出什么遗憾悲戚的诗词出来。　　结果，题目刚说完，唐逸竟然说他已经写完了？连题目都不用审？这开什么玩笑？　　而且还扬言他若出手，别人连出手的机会都没有了。　　这是何等的狂妄！　　“唐安，你……确定写好了？”孔诗岚字咬得有些重，提醒唐逸。　　“放心吧，早写好了的。”唐逸笑着看向孔诗岚，给了她一个放心的眼神。　　本来是不知道怎么写的，但你一个转折，这不就帮我写好了。　　只是看到他自信的样子，孔诗岚眉头皱了皱，放心，我放心你个鬼。　　这可是事关我的终身大事，你要是输了我的终身大事也就完了。　　要是让秦钰，或者宇文封赢了，那我还不得远嫁异国他乡？　　虽然皇帝说了沈园诗会后，不会再干涉我的婚事，但这事目前就只有我和皇帝知道，他要是不认账怎么办？　　“呵，四弟还真是自信啊！既然写好了，那就亮出来让大家赏析吧！”　　“我很想看看，四弟你在这么短的时间，是如何写出一首精妙绝伦的诗词的。”　　唐画转了转折扇，连忙开口说道。　　他笑容嘲讽，觉得唐逸和他一样，是在故意拖延时间，只是唐逸选择的方式和他不一样，自然不能让他得逞。　　“能在这么短的时间写出诗词，不愧是小诗仙，佩服。”　　秦钰笑着拱了拱手，目光带着审视道：“唐画兄说得对，那请小诗仙将诗词写出来，让我等先学习学习，如何？”　　“呵！无趣。”宇文封冷眼扫了眼唐逸，冷笑一声。　　搞那些酸溜溜的东西真是麻烦，换成他，没有一箭解决不了的事情。　　如果有，那就两箭！　　“对，有本事将你写的诗词亮出来，让我们瞅瞅，少装逼。”　　“吹什么吹，这么短的时间就写好了诗词，老子不信。”　　“靠，我也是十年寒窗熬过来的，诗词何其难，竟被他说得如此轻松，说得我们像是白痴一样。”　　“……”　　舞台上，一众参赛的学子才子也都声讨唐逸，声音充满嘲讽和不屑。　　没人相信他能在这么短的时间能写出什么绝佳的诗词，都以为他是在吹牛，在装逼，忍不住要在众目睽睽之下，将他真面目揭开！　　唐逸看着众人激动愤懑的样子，笑着摇了摇头：“我就是说句实话而已，你们这么大反应做什么？”　　“好吧！既然你们有这需求，那我就成全你们。”　　“走你们的路，让你们无路可走。”　　唐逸当即起身，取下笔架上的毛笔，蘸墨在桌上的宣纸上落笔。　　《衩头凤·红酥手》……　　所有人的目光都落在唐逸的身上，议论声顿时又开始跌宕起伏。　　特别是唐敬，刘温等大臣看着唐逸认真的样子，目光都玩味而戏谑，装，你继续装，装得还挺像。　　炎文帝虽然脸色平静，但手已经下意识握成拳，心里明显很紧张。　　孔诗岚也是下意识抿起了唇，心跳加速，不是她对唐逸有意见，而是综合这家伙的情况，总觉得这家伙很不靠谱啊！　　颜霜玉，姜云娜这时也是攥紧拳头，只是她们完全是激动的，哈哈，这废物的狐狸尾巴，终于露出来了！　　小诗仙？呸，等着身败名裂吧！　　片刻，唐逸停笔，随即随手将毛笔丢在桌上。　　他看向孔诗岚，道：“喏，孔姑娘，写好了……嗯，忽然文思泉涌，一不小心就写了两首。”　　听到这话，原本喧嚣的全场，瞬间寂静下来。　　所有人的盯着唐逸。　　忽然文思泉涌，一不小心写了两首？　　听听，这是人话吗？！　　兔崽子，你还真是什么都敢说……炎文帝也不淡定了，下意识想要怒斥，只是话没出口，唐敬的声音已经传来。　　“我忍不了了！”　　唐敬猛地站了起来，指着唐逸道：“孔姑娘，立即看一下他写的什么乱七八糟的东西，好叫他立即滚下台来，丢人现眼。”　　这话一出，瞬间引爆全场。　　“哈哈，连他老子都忍不住了，足以见这家伙写的肯定不是什么好东西。”　　“这么短的时间，能写一首已经够离谱了，瞧不起谁呢这是？”　　“他要是能写两首传世之作，老子直接倒立吃屎！”　　“我也是，他要是真能在这么短的时间写出两首，老子进宫当太监去……”　　“……”　　现场众人顿时大怒，甚至很多大人物全然不顾身份，口出秽语。　　“我说你们，太不理智了，也太不冷静了。”　　唐逸手指了指众人，一脸无奈：“既然你们觉得脸还不够肿，那我就成全你们。”　　话落，他拾起桌上的两张宣纸，递给了孔诗岚。　　孔诗岚呆呆接过纸张，美眸往纸张上看去。　　结果一眼，她便直接呆在当场！
content_en: Although Emperor Yanwen believed in Tang Yi, he felt a little scared in his heart now.In today's big drama, he played a very big role, leaving almost no escape route.If this goes wrong, it will be a lot of fun.He wanted to use Tang Yi to suppress the arrogance of these court ministers, but if the arrogance failed to hit them, he would hit himself in the face first."You bastard, what are you doing?" Tang Jing's face was gloomy. Even though Emperor Yan Wen had confirmed Tang Yi's identity, in his eyes, Tang Yi was still far inferior to Tang Hua.Tang Hua has not yet been written, so why should Tang Yi write it first?"Hmph! Your Majesty calls you Little Poet Fairy, do you really think you are a god?" Liu Wen, Zhao Ke and other ministers also sneered.The emperor just used Tang Yi to stomp on their faces.Now, they are eager for Tang Yi to make a fool of himself!Moreover, they are high-ranking civil servants in Dayan, a small group of people at the top of the literary world in Dayan, and they know very well how difficult it is to write an excellent poem.Otherwise, they would have become famous scholars all over the world."Idiot, I don't know how to trick your majesty into becoming a little poetry fairy. Now in this situation, you dare to be so arrogant. You are simply seeking death!" Yan Shuangyu stared at Tang Yi and sneered. Like Tang Jing, she did not want to admit that Tang Yi was outstanding.How could her son lose to the son of that woman Liu Ruyu?"That's just right. A waste like him should be ruined and never be reincarnated!" Jiang Yunna stood beside Yan Shuangyu, her expression still extremely vicious.Tang Yi's few words made her lose face. Now she couldn't wait to see Tang Yi like a dog, being stepped on by Tang Hua.Tang Hua and Qin Yu were also stunned. Originally, they deliberately proposed to let Tang Yi go first, not as a courtesy, but because they wanted to embarrass Tang Yi first, but they didn't expect Tang Yi to say... He had already written the poem?!In the little time he spent talking to them, he wrote the poem?How is this possible?Even Kong Shilan's pretty face was slightly stiff at this time, and her beautiful eyes looked at Tang Yi carefully.She racked her brains to come up with this topic, and it was quite difficult. She had the same idea as the old lady, that is, she didn't think that these young men who had never experienced love would write any regretful and sad poems.As a result, just after finishing the topic, Tang Yi actually said that he had finished writing it?You don’t even need to review the questions?Is this a joke?And he also threatened that if he takes action, others will not even have a chance to take action.How arrogant this is!"Tang An, are you...sure you have finished writing?" Kong Shilan reminded Tang Yi, biting the words a bit too hard."Don't worry, it's been written a long time ago." Tang Yi looked at Kong Shilan with a smile and gave her a reassuring look.I didn’t know how to write it originally, but with a twist, you helped me write it.Just seeing his confident look, Kong Shilan frowned. Don't worry, I don't worry, you idiot.This is a matter of my life. If you lose, my life will be over.If Qin Yu or Yu Wenfeng wins, then I still have to marry in a foreign country?Although the emperor said that he would not interfere with my marriage after the Shen Yuan Poetry Meeting, only the emperor and I know about this matter. What if he refuses to admit it?"Oh, fourth brother is really confident! Now that it's written, let's show it for everyone to appreciate!" "I really want to see, fourth brother, how you wrote such an exquisite poem in such a short time." Tang Hua turned his fan and said quickly.He smiled sarcastically, feeling that Tang Yi was deliberately delaying time just like him, but Tang Yi chose a different method from him, so naturally he couldn't succeed."You are worthy of being a poetry fairy for being able to write poems in such a short time. I admire you." Qin Yu smiled and cupped his hands, looking at him carefully and said, "Brother Tang Hua is right. How about asking the poetry fairy to write out the poems and let me study them first?" "Ha! It's boring." Yu Wenfeng glanced at Tang Yi coldly and sneered.Dealing with those sour things is really troublesome. If it were him, there would be nothing that couldn't be solved with one arrow.If there is, then two arrows!"Yes, you have the ability to show the poems you wrote, let us take a look, stop pretending." "What are you bragging about? I wrote the poems in such a short time, I don't believe it." "Damn, I also lived in the cold for ten years.Come here, poetry is so difficult, but he made it so easy, making us look like idiots." "..." On the stage, all the students and talents participating in the competition also criticized Tang Yi, their voices full of ridicule and disdain.No one believed that he could write any excellent poems in such a short period of time. They all thought that he was bragging and showing off, and they couldn't help but reveal his true identity in front of everyone!Tang Yi looked at everyone's excited and angry expressions, smiled and shook his head: "I'm just telling the truth, why are you reacting so hard?" "Okay! Since you have this need, then I will grant it to you." "Go your way and leave you with nowhere to go." Tang Yi immediately stood up, took off the brush from the pen holder, dipped it in ink and wrote on the rice paper on the table."Pornographic Phoenix: Red Hands"... Everyone's eyes fell on Tang Yi, and the discussion suddenly started to fluctuate again.Especially Tang Jing, Liu Wen and other ministers looked at Tang Yi's serious look, their eyes were playful and playful, pretend, you continue to pretend, it looks pretty good.Although Emperor Yan Wen's face was calm, his hands had been clenched into fists subconsciously, and he was obviously very nervous.Kong Shilan also pursed her lips subconsciously, and her heart beat faster. It wasn't that she had any problem with Tang Yi, but based on this guy's situation, she always felt that this guy was very unreliable!Yan Shuangyu and Jiang Yunna also clenched their fists at this time, but they were completely excited. Haha, the fox tail of this loser was finally exposed!Little Poet Fairy?Bah, wait until you are ruined!For a moment, Tang Yi stopped writing and then threw the brush on the table.He looked at Kong Shilan and said, "Here, Miss Kong, it's finished... Well, suddenly I got a flood of literary thoughts and accidentally wrote two poems." Upon hearing this, the originally noisy whole place fell silent instantly.Everyone stared at Tang Yi.Suddenly, my thoughts surged, and I accidentally wrote two poems?Listen, is this human talk?!Rabbit
